syllabus_items.text: Discrete Mathematics: Propositional and first order logic
Discrete Mathematics: Sets, relations, functions, partial orders and lattices
Discrete Mathematics: Graphs: connectivity, matching, colouring
Discrete Mathematics: Combinatorics: counting, recurrence relations, generating functions
Linear Algebra: System of linear equations
Probability and Statistics: Uniform, normal, exponential, Poisson and binomial distributions
Probability and Statistics: Mean, median, mode and standard deviation
Probability and Statistics: Conditional probability and Bayes theorem
Boolean algebra and minimization: algebraic technique, Karnaugh map, tabular method
Design of combinational and sequential circuits
Number representation and arithmetic (fixed and floating point)
Design of arithmetic and logic unit (ALU)
Design of control unit: hardwired and microprogrammed
Memory interfacing and hierarchy: performance, cache memory mapping
Asymptotic worst case time and space complexity
Algorithm design techniques: greedy, dynamic programming and divide-and-conquer
Regular and context-free languages, pumping lemma
Data flow analyses: constant propagation, liveness analysis, common sub expression elimination
Relational model: relational algebra, tuple calculus, SQL
Basics of switching (circuit, packet and virtual circuit) and performance metrics
Data link layer: error detection, Medium Access Control, Ethernet
Distance vector and link state routing
IPv4: Fragmentation, CIDR Notation, Network Address Translation
TCP: flow control and congestion control, socket API
Mean, median, mode and standard deviation
Discrete random variables and probability mass functions
Continuous random variables and probability distribution function
Uniform, exponential, Poisson, normal, standard normal, t-distribution, chi-squared distributions
Linear dependence and independence of vectors
Systems of linear equations and solutions
Basic data structures: stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, hash tables
Search algorithms: linear search and binary search
Basic sorting algorithms: selection sort, bubble sort and insertion sort
Basic graph algorithms: traversals and shortest path
Relational model: relational algebra, tuple calculus, SQL
Data transformation such as normalization, discretization, sampling, compression
Data warehouse modelling: schema for multidimensional data models, concept hierarchies
Supervised learning: regression and classification problems
Cross-validation methods such as leave-one-out (LOO) cross-validation, k-folds cross-validation
Hierarchical clustering: top-down, bottom-up: single-linkage, multiple-linkage
Reasoning under uncertainty: conditional independence representation
Basic English grammar: tenses, articles, adjectives, prepositions, conjunctions, verb-noun agreement, and other parts of speech
Basic vocabulary: words, idioms, and phrases in context
Data interpretation: data graphs (bar graphs, pie charts, and other graphs representing data)
Numerical computation and estimation: ratios, percentages, powers, exponents and logarithms, permutations and combinations, and series
Transformation of shapes: translation, rotation, scaling, mirroring, assembling, and grouping
Paper folding, cutting, and patterns in 2 and 3 dimensions
